seo.title: About Us
seo.description: Over 26 years simplifying corporate management. Discover the history, mission, and technology behind Interfy, headquartered in Orlando (USA) and present in more than 180 countries.

hero.headingPrefix: Simplifying the Complex, Transforming the Present,
hero.description: For more than two decades we've been transforming corporate management through innovative, accessible technology. Headquartered in Orlando (USA), we serve companies in more than 180 countries, empowering organizations to leave legacy systems behind and embrace operational agility.
hero.slideshowAlt: Interfy platform shown on laptop and smartphone, displaying the AI-powered management dashboard

history.paragraph1: Interfy isn't an early-stage startup — it's an established company with more than 26 years of experience developing corporate management technology. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida (USA), we build solutions that serve companies worldwide. Our technology is designed to operate across diverse regulatory and cultural environments, ensuring global flexibility and compliance.
history.paragraph2: Our platform is tested in the world's most demanding corporate environments. From the US market to Latin America and Europe, we serve more than 180 countries with the same excellence and robustness that define our brand.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: To be recognized for generating value for our clients around the world, delivering an online corporate management software platform that is accessible, mobile, and easy to use.
